title_src: A plague scare in Siberia tests Russia's credibility
title_zh: 西伯利亚瘟疫疑云考验俄罗斯的公信力
lead_zh: 一名 28 岁研究员在俄罗斯伊尔库茨克防鼠疫研究所死亡，引发“实验室泄漏”恐慌。事件本身尚未证实，但俄罗斯的不透明更令人不安——本文梳理已知事实、鼠疫的两种形态，以及生物武器的历史与现实。学习重点：pathogen、unfounded、transmissibility 等高频词，以及 the questions outnumber the answers、take sb at their word 等写作金句。

paragraphs.text: THE RUMOURS that emerged sounded like the opening of a thriller. A young woman working in a Siberian research lab supposedly breaks a test tube containing a lethal plague pathogen. She is dead within 48 hours. Authorities race to contain the situation. The questions outnumber the answers, breeding suggestions of [[conspiracy]]. The fears may prove [[unfounded]]: there may not have been a leak at Russia’s Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute. But the world can be forgiven for its panicked interest.
paragraphs.zh: 传出的谣言听起来像惊悚片的开头。一名在西伯利亚某研究实验室工作的年轻女子，据称打碎了一支含有致命鼠疫病原体的试管。48 小时内她便告不治。当局紧急控制局面。问题比答案多，阴谋论随之滋生。这些担忧最终可能被证明毫无根据：俄罗斯伊尔库茨克防鼠疫研究所或许并未发生泄漏。但全世界为之恐慌关注，也情有可原。

words.note_zh: 美式拼写 rumor；the rumours that emerged 传出的种种传闻
lethal = deadly，比 dangerous 语气强得多
breeding suggestions of conspiracy 催生了阴谋论的猜测
un- + found（建立）+ -ed：没有根据的；rumour fears prove unfounded

sentences.text: The questions outnumber the answers, breeding suggestions of conspiracy.

structure.text: The questions outnumber the answers —— 主句：问题比答案多（outnumber = 在数量上超过）
breeding suggestions of conspiracy —— 现在分词短语作结果状语，breed 本义“滋生、酿成”

sentences.tip_zh: 写作金句：The questions outnumber the answers 可直接用于“信息扑朔迷离/不透明”类话题的开头。

paragraphs.text: Some facts are not under dispute. Darya Shipilova, a 28-year-old researcher at the institute, died at a regional hospital on October 2nd. Around 200 of Ms Shipilova’s contacts have been placed under medical observation, suggesting authorities believe she may have died of an infectious disease. But no cause of death has been officially confirmed, according to the World Health Organisation (WHO). Russia’s federal health watchdog claimed to have found “no evidence of microorganisms related to her professional activities”, and said the cause of death was “pneumonia of unknown etiology”.
paragraphs.zh: 有些事实无可争议。该研究所 28 岁的研究员达里娅·希皮洛娃于 10 月 2 日在一家地区医院去世。希皮洛娃约 200 名接触者已被置于医学观察之下，这表明当局认为她可能死于传染病。但据世界卫生组织（WHO）说法，死因尚未得到官方证实。俄罗斯联邦卫生监督机构声称“未发现与她职业活动相关的微生物”，并称死因为“病因不明的肺炎”。

words.note_zh: not under dispute 无可争议；be in dispute 有争议
federal health watchdog 联邦卫生监督机构；媒体常用隐喻
pneumonia of unknown etiology 病因不明的肺炎；医学高频词
place contacts under medical observation 将接触者置于医学观察

sentences.text: Russia’s federal health watchdog claimed to have found “no evidence of microorganisms related to her professional activities”, and said the cause of death was “pneumonia of unknown etiology”.

structure.text: Russia’s federal health watchdog claimed ... and said ... —— 并列谓语：声称……并称……
to have found —— 完成式不定式，表示“声称已发现”（动作先于 claim 发生）
of unknown etiology —— of + 抽象名词作后置定语，相当于“病因不明的”

sentences.tip_zh: claim to have done = 声称已做过某事。转述官方消息时比 said that ... 更精炼，考研写作常用。

paragraphs.text: Beyond confirming the death Russian officials have provided little information, though they are urgently implementing regional control measures. On Monday Marco Rubio, America’s secretary of state, said that his government is “watching and monitoring it closely”. With the covid pandemic still a recent memory, it is no wonder the world has shown close interest. Inevitably, some have asked if the incident is connected to Russia’s biological warfare programme, which Western intelligence services say is still active.
paragraphs.zh: 除确认死亡外，俄罗斯官员几乎没有提供任何信息，尽管他们正在紧急实施区域管控措施。周一，美国国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥表示，美国政府正“密切关注此事”。新冠疫情记忆犹新，全世界密切关注此事不足为奇。一些人不可避免地追问：此事是否与俄罗斯的生物战计划有关——西方情报机构称该计划至今仍在运行。

words.note_zh: implement control measures 实施管控措施；名词 implementation
句首副词，带出“意料之中的反应”
常用复数：Western intelligence services 西方多国情报机构
warfare 作不可数名词：chemical/psychological warfare

sentences.text: Inevitably, some have asked if the incident is connected to Russia’s biological warfare programme, which Western intelligence services say is still active.

structure.text: some have asked if ... —— 主句：一些人追问是否……（if 引导宾语从句）
which ... is still active —— 非限制性定语从句，修饰 programme
Western intelligence services say 是插入语（主谓结构），先跳过它抓主干：which is still active

sentences.tip_zh: 长难句常见干扰：从句中插入“某人说”。解题时先删掉插入语，主干立刻清晰。

paragraphs.text: The bacterium Yersinia pestis, generically known as “plague”, manifests in two forms. Every year thousands of cases of bubonic plague occur naturally when people catch it after contact with wildlife such as rodents. Bubonic plague is treatable with antibiotics if caught early, but untreated it can become pneumonic plague, which can be transmitted via respiratory droplets. This is harder to treat and has a higher [[mortality rate]]. Legitimate reasons exist for study of the [[pathogen]], such as to understand how it causes disease, and to develop vaccines and treatments.
paragraphs.zh: 耶尔森氏菌（俗称“鼠疫”）有两种形态。每年有数千例腺鼠疫在自然条件下发生，人们因接触啮齿类等野生动物而感染。腺鼠疫若早期发现，可用抗生素治疗；但若不加治疗，可能发展为肺鼠疫，后者可通过飞沫传播。它更难治疗，死亡率也更高。研究这一病原体有正当理由，例如弄清其致病机理，以及研发疫苗与疗法。

words.note_zh: 形容词 pathogenic 致病的；医学英语核心词
bubonic 腺体的；对应 pneumonic plague 肺鼠疫
-able 后缀：treatable / curable / preventable
区分：mortality 死亡率 / morbidity 发病率
respiratory /rəˈspɪrətri/；covid 语境高频词

sentences.text: Bubonic plague is treatable with antibiotics if caught early, but untreated it can become pneumonic plague, which can be transmitted via respiratory droplets.

structure.text: Bubonic plague is treatable ... but (it) can become pneumonic plague —— 转折并列的两个主句
if caught early = if it is caught early；untreated = if it is untreated —— 状语从句省略主语 + be 的典型
which can be transmitted via respiratory droplets —— 非限制性定语从句，说明传播途径

sentences.tip_zh: 科技英语高频：状语从句省略（if + 过去分词 / 形容词）。写作中模仿可显著提升句式密度。

paragraphs.text: But Filippa Lentzos, a biosecurity expert at King’s College London, says the lack of [[transparency]] around the incident in Siberia is worrying. Plague is one of a group of high-risk pathogens that have easy [[transmissibility]] and high mortality rates, including anthrax, smallpox, and viral hemorrhagic fevers such as Ebola. Biosafety laboratories are proliferating around the world, raising the likelihood of accidents.
paragraphs.zh: 但伦敦国王学院生物安全专家菲利帕·伦茨表示，西伯利亚事件缺乏透明度令人担忧。鼠疫属于一类高危病原体——传播性强、死亡率高，同类还包括炭疽、天花，以及埃博拉等病毒性出血热。生物安全实验室在世界各地不断增多，事故概率随之上升。

words.note_zh: the lack of transparency 缺乏透明度；反义 secrecy / opacity
transmit（传播）→ transmissible → transmissibility
bio- 前缀：biosafety 生物安全（设施层面）/ biosecurity（更广）
核武器、实验室、数据皆可用；名词 proliferation
raise the likelihood of … 提高……的可能性；= probability

sentences.text: Plague is one of a group of high-risk pathogens that have easy transmissibility and high mortality rates, including anthrax, smallpox, and viral hemorrhagic fevers such as Ebola.

structure.text: Plague is one of a group of high-risk pathogens —— 主句：鼠疫是高危病原体之一
that have easy transmissibility and high mortality rates —— 定语从句修饰 pathogens（复数）
including ... and ... such as Ebola —— 两级举例扩展（including 列举 + such as 细化）

sentences.tip_zh: “one of + 复数名词 + that 从句”从句谓语用复数。举例链 including → such as 的递进也值得模仿。

paragraphs.text: These pathogens are also considered prime candidates for use in bioweapons. Plague can be [[aerosolised]] to ease transmission to humans and genetically modified to make it resistant to antibiotics. Despite [[ratifying]] the Biological Weapons Convention in 1975, the Soviet Union ran an extensive [[covert]] bioweapons programme. In 1992 Boris Yeltsin, then president of Russia, acknowledged the programme and agreed to dismantle it. But more recently Russia has maintained secrecy around its military biological-research facilities. Satellite imagery of one such site outside Moscow indicates significant expansion since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. In 2023 a report on treaty compliance by America’s State Department concluded that Russia maintains an offensive biological weapons programme.
paragraphs.zh: 这些病原体也被视为生物武器的首选材料。鼠疫可被气溶胶化以增强人际传播，也可经基因改造以对抗生素产生耐药性。尽管 1975 年就批准了《生物武器公约》，苏联却长期运行着庞大的秘密生物武器计划。1992 年，时任俄罗斯总统鲍里斯·叶利钦承认了该计划并同意拆除。但近年来，俄罗斯对其军事生物研究设施一直讳莫如深。莫斯科郊外一处此类设施的卫星图像显示，自 2022 年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以来，该设施显著扩建。2023 年，美国国务院一份条约履约报告的结论是：俄罗斯仍在运行进攻性生物武器计划。

words.note_zh: aerosol 气溶胶 + -ise；生物武器语境高频词
名词 ratification；注意：sign 签署 ≠ ratify 批准
covert programme 秘密计划；反义 overt 公开的；读音 /ˈkʌvɜːt/
dismantle a programme/system 拆除计划/体系
treaty compliance 条约履约情况；in compliance with 遵照

sentences.text: Despite ratifying the Biological Weapons Convention in 1975, the Soviet Union ran an extensive covert bioweapons programme.

structure.text: the Soviet Union ran an extensive covert bioweapons programme —— 主句：苏联运行了庞大的秘密生物武器计划
Despite ratifying ... —— 让步状语：尽管批准了……（despite + 动名词）

sentences.tip_zh: 高分让步句式：Despite doing A, S did B。注意 despite 是介词，后接名词/动名词，不接句子（不能接 although 从句）。

paragraphs.text: Based on the unofficial information currently available on the situation in Irkutsk, the WHO believes the risk to the general population to be low. No evidence suggests that the institute in Irkutsk is linked to bioweapons activities, and Russia insists its cloaked military sites only undertake defensive research. But Russia said the same thing about its chemical-weapons research before it attempted to assassinate Sergei Skripal, a Russian defector in Britain, with a military-grade nerve poison in 2018. There may be nothing to the lab-leak rumours. But with so little transparency, it is hard to take Russia at its word.
paragraphs.zh: 根据目前关于伊尔库茨克局势的非官方信息，世卫组织认为普通民众面临的风险较低。没有证据显示伊尔库茨克研究所与生物武器活动有关联，俄罗斯坚称其秘密军事设施只进行防御性研究。但 2018 年俄罗斯叛逃者谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔在英国遭军用级神经毒剂暗杀未遂之前，俄罗斯对化学武器研究也说过同样的话。实验室泄漏的谣言或许空穴来风。但在如此缺乏透明度的情况下，很难轻信俄罗斯的一面之词。

words.note_zh: un- + official；unofficial information 非官方消息
公共卫生语境高频：risk to the general population 对普通民众的风险
insist + (that) 从句：坚称……；注意与 persist 区分
反义 offensive 进攻性的；defensive research 防御性研究

sentences.text: But with so little transparency, it is hard to take Russia at its word.

structure.text: it is hard to take Russia at its word —— 主句：it 为形式主语，to do 为真正主语
with so little transparency —— 介词短语表原因/背景：在如此缺乏透明度的情况下
take sb at their word = 相信某人的话，不加怀疑地接受

sentences.tip_zh: 文章收束金句。take sb at one's word 直接进写作；it is hard to do 也是万能评价句式。

background.body_zh: 鼠疫（plague）由耶尔森氏菌（Yersinia pestis）引起，常见宿主为啮齿类动物。它有两种主要形态：腺鼠疫（bubonic plague）经跳蚤叮咬传播，早期可用抗生素治愈；肺鼠疫（pneumonic plague）侵犯肺部，可经飞沫人传人，死亡率更高。世卫组织将鼠疫列为重新出现的传染病，全球每年仍有数千例报告。
《生物武器公约》（BWC）1972 年签署、1975 年生效，禁止研发生物与毒素武器。但它没有强制核查机制，履约主要靠缔约国自查与情报判断——这正是文中“缺乏透明度”争论的制度根源。文章提到的斯克里帕尔事件（2018 年英国索尔兹伯里神经毒剂案）常被西方国家用作质疑俄方履约诚意的例证。

expressions.expr: sound like the opening of a thriller
expressions.zh: 听起来像惊悚片的开头
expressions.usage_zh: 开头制造悬念的修辞：sounded like the opening of a thriller

expressions.zh: 问题比答案多；扑朔迷离
expressions.usage_zh: 形容局势信息混乱；outnumber = 在数量上超过
常用于官方辟谣语境：The fears may prove unfounded

expressions.expr: Despite doing A, S did B
expressions.zh: 尽管做了 A，（主语）却做了 B
expressions.usage_zh: 让步对比高分句式；despite 后接名词/动名词，不接句子

expressions.zh: 轻信某人的话；不加怀疑地接受
expressions.usage_zh: 收尾金句：it is hard to take Russia at its word
prime = 首要的：prime candidates for use in bioweapons

quiz.q: What does the article say about the cause of Darya Shipilova’s death?
options: It was confirmed as bubonic plague.
It was confirmed as a laboratory accident.
It has not been officially confirmed.
It was caused by a genetically modified pathogen.
quiz.explanation_zh: 第二段明确说：据 WHO，死因尚未官方证实（no cause of death has been officially confirmed）；俄方仅称“病因不明的肺炎”。A、B 与原文矛盾；D 属无中生有的阴谋论猜测。

quiz.q: The word “unfounded” (Paragraph 1) is closest in meaning to ______.
quiz.explanation_zh: un-（否定）+ found（建立）+ -ed：没有建立在事实之上的，即“毫无根据的”。原文 The fears may prove unfounded 意为“担忧可能被证明毫无根据”。

quiz.q: Why is the lack of transparency around the incident worrying, according to the article?
options: Because plague cannot be treated with antibiotics.
Because high-risk pathogens in proliferating labs raise accident and bioweapon risks.
Because the WHO has refused to monitor the situation.
Because Russia has withdrawn from the Biological Weapons Convention.
quiz.explanation_zh: 第五、六段逻辑链：高危病原体（传播性强、死亡率高）+ 实验室激增 = 事故概率上升；且此类病原体是生物武器首选材料。A 偷换概念（早期可治）；C 与原文相反（WHO 在评估）；D 无中生有（俄未退约，而是被质疑履约）。

quiz.q: Despite ______ (ratify) the Biological Weapons Convention in 1975, the Soviet Union ran an extensive covert bioweapons programme.
quiz.explanation_zh: despite 是介词，后接名词或动名词，故用 ratifying。若要用从句，需改写为 Although the Soviet Union ratified ... 。这也是本文最值得背诵的让步句式。

discussion_zh: 面对“可能的实验室泄漏”传闻，公众、媒体与政府各自应承担怎样的责任？
你认为国际社会应如何提高高危病原体研究的透明度？可参考《生物武器公约》的核查困境。
文章结尾说：“There may be nothing to the rumours. But with so little transparency, it is hard to take Russia at its word.” 你如何看待“不透明即不可信”这一逻辑？

writing.title_zh: 写作练习：Scientific transparency and public trust
writing.prompt_zh: 假定你是李华，校英文报就“科学研究透明度与公众信任”征文。请写一篇 150 词左右的短评：1）概述西伯利亚事件引发的关注；2）分析透明度对公众信任的重要性；3）提出你的建议。至少使用 2 个本文学到的表达（如 the questions outnumber the answers / take sb at their word / Despite doing A, S did B）。
